_comment: Golden reset manifest for the 26 streamhost input-regression tiles plus the 4 emulator-bridge retro tiles (c64/atarist/apple2/amiga; on those, mouse/keyboard 'UNVERIFIED' = input verdicts not yet pixel-certified). Keyed by osId (the SPA ?streamhost=<osId> id, the /signal/<osId>.json key, and the /restore/<osId> path segment). resetMode=loadvm restores the in-qcow2 live `golden` snapshot via QMP (fast, no restart, RAM+devices exact); resetMode=restart cold-boots the tile's curated fixture by re-running qemu-streamhost.sh + restarting streamhost@ (for tiles whose backing store cannot hold a vmstate snapshot). NON-DESTRUCTIVE: reset only restores/relaunches, it never runs savevm. mouse/keyboard = the visually-certified per-input verdict (PASS = a reaction was pixel-verified on the guest's QMP framebuffer by an agent reading before/after PNGs; SKIP = input IS delivered over the open control channel but a documented guest limitation prevents pixel-verification off the captured VGA framebuffer).
